name: Binary Tract Masks
summary: Generates one binary NIfTI volume mask per segmented white matter tract from a tract classification and tractogram, using a compiled MATLAB script with vistasoft.
description: Rebuilds each tract from the white matter classification and whole-brain tractogram, maps its streamline nodes into the T1 image grid at a chosen voxel size, counts streamline visits per voxel and binarizes the result either by Gaussian smoothing and a 20th-percentile cut or by a fixed streamline-count threshold. Use it to obtain tract volume masks for ROI-based or shape analyses. The T1 must be ACPC-aligned and in the same space as the tractogram.

inputs.description: ACPC-aligned T1-weighted image used as the reference grid for the masks.
inputs.requirements: Must be in the same space as the tractogram.

inputs.description: White matter classification (classification.mat) assigning streamlines of the tractogram to named tracts.
Whole-brain .tck tractogram that the classification indexes.

outputs.description: A masks directory with one binary <tract>_Vol.nii.gz mask per non-empty tract and a color.json of tract colours.

parameters.description: Streamline-count threshold per voxel used to binarize the mask when smooth is false.
If true, smooth the streamline-count volume with a 3x3x3 Gaussian and keep voxels above the 20th percentile of non-zero values instead of using threshold.
Isotropic voxel size of the output masks (the T1 grid is resampled to this size).

citations.text: Kitchell L. Shape Analysis of Human White Matter Tracts: An Examination of Normal Morphological Variability and the Association Between Morphology, Brain Size, and Behavior. Indiana University (2020).

failure_modes.fix: Some tract masks were not written; check that the classification matches the tractogram and that tracts are non-empty.
